title: Vector-Carleson, Calderón, and Poisson-Atomic Criteria for Generalized Hilbert Operators on $H^p$, $p>2$
summary: Let $\mathcal H_g f(z)=\int_0^1 f(t)g'(tz),dt$, and let $2<p<\infty$. Set $t=2p/(p-2)$ and $X_j=2^{-j/p'}Δ_j g'$, where $Δ_j$ is the hard dyadic Taylor projection. We prove that $\mathcal H_g:H^p\to H^p$ is bounded if and only if $h\mapsto(X_jh)_{j\geq0}$ is bounded from $H^t$ to $\ell^t(H^2)$. The square of this embedding norm equals the norm of the positive column operator $b\mapsto\sum_j b_j|X_j|^2$ from $\ell^{p/2}$ to $L^{p/2}$.
